named_method: Hybrid MAPF solver combining MARL-inspired coordination, LNS-style repair, and prioritized planning

definition.marl_component: Use agent-interaction-aware ordering heuristic as a lightweight MARL-inspired coordination proxy due absence of training labels and simulator interface in workspace.
definition.lns_component: Iteratively select conflicted agents and replan a local neighborhood while holding others fixed.
definition.prioritized_planning_component: Sequential single-agent planning under reservation constraints.

assumptions: Workspace contains occupancy grids but no explicit start-goal tasks; tasks are synthesized by valid sampling.
Exact MARL training is infeasible within benchmark time/data context because no environment API or labeled trajectories are provided.
invariants: No vertex collisions in successful plans
No swap collisions in successful plans
Paths remain on free cells only
non_negotiable_steps: Run local repair on conflicted subset
Report success rate, runtime, and path-cost metrics
deviation: Uses MARL-inspired congestion-aware ordering instead of trained MARL policy.
reason: No explicit task/scenario files or RL environment hooks were present in workspace-visible assets.
